success.description: You create a foul cloud of corruption that engulfs your enemies and poisons them with mutating Dhar energy. All affected enemies suffer 1 critical wound, and they suffer 1 normal wound each time a recharge token is removed from this card.
As above, but draw 3 critical wounds, choose 1 to apply to the target, and apply the other two as normal wounds. The targets suffer 1 wound.

sigmarsComet.description: The targets must pass an Average (2{Dc}) Resilience check or gain 1 permanent wound.
